title: Marketing Ad Arena (ad_arena.v1)
description: One pre-registered split test. Emitted by engine/marketing/ad_arena.py. primary_metric is FROZEN at creation — secondary_metrics are exploratory and may never trigger a stop, a kill, or a budget shift (AD_CENTRAL_MASTERPLAN.md §0 G-E). assignment_weights are likewise frozen: the allocator varies spend, never assignment, so a returning unit cannot change arms mid-test.

n_floor.description: Assignments per arm required before ANY verdict, promotion, kill, or scale-up (G-D).

guardrails.description: Ceilings on harm (refund rate, unsubscribe rate). A breach HALTS the arena; a guardrail can never declare a winner.
